package.name: wojtek_voice
package.description: Voice pipeline nodes for Wojtek's agentic stack: the browser audio bridge (websocket mic/speaker), the VAD/segmentation node and the Whisper ASR node. Heavy model dependencies (faster-whisper, torch, pyannote) are NOT rosdep-resolvable; install requirements.txt into the deployment venv (see docs/plans/agentic-ros2.md).
